  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  of Thursday, February 1, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52184  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE 23-154 and approve a
  Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-014) and a Local Coastal Development Permit
  (LCDP23-041) to allow on-site sales of beer and wine (Type 41) in conjunction with

  appealable area of the Coastal Zone at 180 East Ocean Blvd #170, within the
  Downtown Shoreline Planned Development District (PD-6). (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:03 PM, Chair Lewis called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Castillo, Clemson, Gonzalez Edmond, LaFarga, Templin, Lewis

Commissioners Absent: Ware

Also present: Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Erin Weesner-McKinley, Deputy City
Attorney, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner LaFarga led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52178  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Templin, seconded by Commissioner
  LaFarga, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Clemson, Gonzalez Edmond, LaFarga, Templin, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Castillo, Ware

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;
  and provided the Director’s Report.

2.  24-52179  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting
  of Thursday, February 1, 2024.

  Yes:  6  Castillo, Clemson, Gonzalez Edmond, LaFarga, Templin, Lewis
